title: Bacterial Growth
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.startupSource:
10 PRINT"COMPUTER SIMULATION OF BACTERIAL GROWTH"
20 READ X,NUT,WASTE
25 SAM=SAM+1
30 IF X=-1 AND NUT=-1 AND WASTE=-1 THEN 600
40 DAY=0
60 RATE =0
65 PRINT:PRINT"SIMULATION ";SAM
70 PRINT"INITIAL BACTERIA COUNT (MILLIONS)",X
80 PRINT"INITIAL NUTRIENT CONCENTRATION (PERCENT)",NUT
90 PRINT"INITIAL WASTE CONSENTRATION (PERCENT)",WASTE
100 RATE = (NUT/10)-(WASTE/10)+1
110 IF RATE < 1 THEN 160 ELSE DAYS=DAYS +1
